title: Mission fund body
description: A funder puts credits into a mission's pool (register row DK1240; spec-delta S1612). Signed by the funder, who pays from its own account (insufficient_balance otherwise). Refused for an unknown mission (mission_unknown), after it closed or settled (mission_closed) and for an amount of nothing. Credits move to the pool account; none are made. Chain: none (prev is null).
